result_summary: Killed at gate. The re-derived per-statement max reranker relevance puts all 4 Set 2 statements above the 0.6 bar (mean 0.996, minimum 0.993) alongside 74 of gold's 77 (share 0.961, mean 0.942), with overlap coefficient 0.818 and Mann-Whitney AUC 0.429, so no threshold on max relevance separates fabrication from faithful compression and the hard-gate variant dies as registered. The set-diff the kill clause calls for confirms the soft weighting is load-bearing but in the wrong direction: ungated R2 reads 0 gold intrusions with correct Set2>Set1 severity (tier means 0.2137 / 0.2716 / 0.6319), while the shipped soft gate reads 6 intrusions with inverted Set1>Set2 severity and collapses the Set 2 tier mean from 0.6319 to 0.0029. The re-derivation reproduces the E06 record exactly (6 intrusions, Set1>Set2), repairing the failing reference the ledger WARNING names and showing the E03-H11 headline 2 -> 0 is inverted to 0 -> 6 on the current models; per-statement max-r is persisted for the first time, closing the artefact gap. Guardrails held: V 0/24, smd and order_gap bit-identical over all 10 anchor pairs, D_sel untouched, D_grd still a score.
caveats: Registered as a research lean; the registered single-phase experiment was executed, which turns it into a modelled test, and the verdict above is that test's, not the lean's. Set 2 is 4 statements from 2 documents (adv2-a segments to a single run-on sentence), so every Set 2 max-r statistic rests on n = 4: the kill-gate's literal condition is met without ambiguity (4/4 above 0.6, minimum 0.993) but the overlap coefficient and AUC are coarse. One fixture only, the same ibm-ai-adoption set E02 through E06 used. The collapse mechanism is the reranker saturating near 1.0 on long fabricated statements that reuse source vocabulary, which may not transfer to fabrication written in genuinely novel language. The hard gate reaches 0 intrusions only at tau 0.9984 and 0.9992, where it excludes almost nothing and its tier means converge back onto the ungated arm's, so its apparent win is the ungated baseline, not a gate. The E03 notebook's stored 0 -> 4 reading differs from both because it scored a two-component Euclidean signature (ungrounded, contradiction) rather than the shipped scalar |grd_a - grd_b|. A follow-up decision on whether to keep the shipped soft gate is out of this hypothesis's scope. The log records the final clean execution; the first full execution built the reranker grid in 339.7 s and cached it to data/interim/E12-H69-grounding-signals.npz, so the re-run restored the signals from cache.
